What is PRP Hair Treatment?

A Natural Boost for Your Hair—No Pills or Transplants Needed

PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) therapy uses your own blood to stimulate hair growth and reduce hair fall—safely and naturally.
PRP therapy involves drawing a small amount of your blood, spinning it in a special machine to concentrate the platelets and growth factors, and then injecting that enriched solution into thinning areas of your scalp.

These platelets help strengthen weak hair roots, reduce hair fall, and promote thicker hair growth.

It’s a completely non-surgical treatment, ideal for both men and women who are in the early stages of hair thinning.
At our clinic, we offer advanced PRP hair treatment in Marathahalli, Whitefield, Bangalore, performed by specialized practitioners and PRP doctors. Our team carefully monitors your progress throughout the treatment to ensure optimal results without side effects.

Originally used in sports medicine to heal injuries, PRP has gained attention as a powerful method for treating hair loss.

How Does PRP Hair Treatment Work?

A Simple 4-Step Process That Works with Your Body

The entire treatment takes under an hour—and there’s no downtime.
✅ Step 1: Consultation & Scalp Assessment
We check your scalp condition and identify areas of thinning. This helps us decide the best approach and number of sessions needed.
✅ Step 2: Blood Collection & Processing
A small amount of your blood is collected and spun in a centrifuge to separate the platelets from other components.
✅ Step 3: Platelet-Rich Plasma Injection
The nutrient-rich PRP solution is injected into the scalp in areas where hair is thinning to stimulate dormant or weak follicles.
✅ Step 4: Post-Procedure & Follow-Up
You can go back to your daily routine immediately. Results typically begin to show after 2–3 sessions.
